decisions.decision: Keep stable toolId banana-helper; expose BZ Goodies. Use adapterId prompt-library for the generic library renderer. No duplicate registration under bz-goodies.

Preserve the actual legacy operation: compile with [Details] and common suffix. Keep label Copier sans détails, correct misleading Raw prompt copied toast. This label is not itself a defect. No extra raw-copy control is needed.

Preserve both constraints and their order, including typography exception in the common suffix. Removing either would change the creative contract. The seven Fun entries remain explicitly text-free; expose full editable text in the future library editor.
Persist detailsByPrompt using entry IDs, never filtered indexes. Preserve edits across search, categories, tool switches, setup duplicates and saved versions.
